caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a wide circular opening at the top. The jar is rendered in beige and brown tones, with a smooth texture and subtle shading indicating roundness. Near the top rim, the jar is inscribed with the characters "I.J.K. 1802" in blue, accompanied by small decorative symbols. Below the inscription, there is a blue decorative pattern consisting of a leafy or vine motif that wraps around the jar, along with a cluster of four blue dots arranged in a floral or clover shape. On either side of the jar, just below the rim, are two stout, blue handles that protrude outward. The background is a plain, light tan color without any additional objects or details.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
